signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.evo:
@Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.evolution_factors_initial : ∀ {W S : Type} (step : ℕ → S → S) (initial : W → S)
  (n : ℕ) (w : W),
  Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial n w =
    Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step (fun z => ↑z) n ⟨initial w, ⋯⟩
signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.fin:
@Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.finite_initial_image_kernel_stabilizes : ∀ {W S : Type} (step : ℕ → S → S)
  (initial : W → S),
  (Set.range initial).Finite →
    ∃ start,
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        start ≤ n →
          ∀ (u v : W),
            Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial start u =
                Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial start v ↔
              Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial n u =
                Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial n v

@Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.finite_trace_initialized_kernel_stabilizes : ∀ {W T S : Type} (trace : W → T)
  (init : T → S) (step : ℕ → S → S),
  (Set.range trace).Finite →
    ∃ start,
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        start ≤ n →
          ∀ (u v : W),
            Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step (init ∘ trace) start u =
                Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step (init ∘ trace) start v ↔
              Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step (init ∘ trace) n u =
                Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step (init ∘ trace) n v
signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.mer:
@Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.merge_iff_capacity_drop : ∀ {W S : Type} (f : W → S) (c : S → S),
  (Set.range f).Finite → ((∃ u v, f u ≠ f v ∧ c (f u) = c (f v)) ↔ (Set.range (c ∘ f)).ncard < (Set.range f).ncard)
signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.sch:
@Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.scheduled_merge_iff_capacity_drop : ∀ {W S : Type} (step : ℕ → S → S)
  (initial : W → S),
  (Set.range initial).Finite →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      (∃ u v,
          Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial n u ≠
              Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial n v ∧
            Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial (n + 1) u =
              Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial (n + 1) v) ↔
        (Set.range (Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial (n + 1))).ncard <
          (Set.range (Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial n)).ncard
signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.str:
Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.strict_drop_budget : ∀ (capacity : ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), capacity (n + 1) ≤ capacity n) →
    ∀ (n : ℕ), Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.dropCount capacity n + capacity n ≤ capacity 0
signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.fin:
@Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.finite_image_merge_budget : ∀ {W S : Type} [Nonempty W] (step : ℕ → S → S)
  (initial : W → S),
  (Set.range initial).Finite →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.dropCount
          (fun k => (Set.range (Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial k)).ncard) n ≤
        (Set.range initial).ncard - 1
signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.del:
Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.delayed_evolution : ∀ (delay n : ℕ) (b : Bool),
  Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration (Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.delayedStep delay) id
      n b =
    if n ≤ delay then b else Bool.false
signatures.Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.mer:
Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.merge_can_be_arbitrarily_late : ∀ (delay : ℕ),
  (∀ n ≤ delay,
      Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration
          (Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.delayedStep delay) id n Bool.false ≠
        Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration
          (Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.delayedStep delay) id n Bool.true) ∧
    Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration (Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.delayedStep delay)
        id (delay + 1) Bool.false =
      Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration
        (Experiments.AbstractLoopsFiniteImage.delayedStep delay) id (delay + 1) Bool.true
